thesis: The episode explores how Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center aligns its investment team with its mission to fund patient care, research, and education through weekly 'memorial moments' that share organizational research and accomplishments. The host recounts how the guest, Jason Klein, transitioned from private equity to multi-asset class investing at a cultural institution after responding to an anonymous job posting and undergoing thirteen interviews.
